Dallas, Texas, USA 05/09 506227−01 *P506227-01* Quick−Start Installation Instructions ComfortSense® 7000 Series Model No. L7742U Touch Screen Programmable Thermostat IMPORTANT! READ THIS FIRST! Before beginning installation, note the type of equipment, number of stages, and any accessories being installed. The ComfortSense® L7742U thermostat is a 24VAC low−voltage thermostat and requires a common wire to the thermostat to operate. Observe the specifications and the DO’s and DO NOT’s that follow: ĊUse 18 gauge thermostat wire or larger. ĊMaximum load 1 Amp or less. DO Ċ Shut off all power to system before installing Ċ Read this entire document, noting which in- structions pertain to your equipment and system requirements. Ċ Make sure that all wiring conforms to local and national building and electrical codes and ordinances. Ċ Use thermostat wire between the thermostat and the optional outdoor temperature sensor (may be separate wire pair or two wires of a multi−wire cable). No shielded or twisted−wire pair is needed. Ċ Consult the ComfortSense® 7000 Series Programming and Application Guide 506228−01. ĊMaximum wire run length 300’ (one way). DO NOT Ċ Install on voltages higher than 30VAC. Ċ Short (jumper) across terminals on the gas valve or at the system control to test installation. This will damage the thermostat and void the warranty. Instead, use testing function in the thermostat shown on back page. Ċ Install on outside walls or in direct sunlight Ċ Install for commercial applications unless used with approved split-system matches, and all wiring and load criteria is been met. Install base in desired location UNPACKAGE THE THERMOSTAT AND OPEN THE CASE WITH A FLAT−BLADE SCREWDRIVER. PLACE BETWEEN BASE AND UNIT AND TWIST TO SEPARATE UNIT FROM BASE. CUT OR DRILL A SMALL HOLE FOR THERMOSTAT WIRING 1/2" 1/2" 1 2 DRILL TWO 3/16" HOLES AT EITHER HORIZONTALLY OR VERTICALLY MARKED LOCATIONS ON WALL FOR ANCHORS PULL ABOUT 3" OF THERMOSTAT WIRE THROUGH OPENING AND REMOVE OUTER THERMOSTAT WIRE JACKET. THIS WILL HELP IN ROUTING THE THERMOSTAT WIRING TO THE PROPER THERMOSTAT TERMINALS 3 TRIM 1/4" INSULATION FROM END OF EACH WIRE 1/4" 4 USE THE UNIT BASE AS A TEMPLATE AND A LEVEL TO MARK TWO MOUNTING HOLE LOCATIONS ON WALL. USE EITHER VERTICAL OR HORIZONTAL HOLES. VERTICAL HORIZONTAL 5 INSERT WALL ANCHORS IN HOLES. TAP DOWN THE ANCHORS UNTIL FLUSH WITH WALL. (USE A LEVEL) ALIGN BASE OVER PLASTIC ANCHORS; SECURE TO WALL USING PROVIDED SCREWS. 6 7 8 9 Connect wiring, seal hole, and setup thermostat 1. Connect wiring between thermostat, indoor unit, and outdoor unit similar to that shown below. See unit-specific wiring diagrams on back page. 2. Connect the outdoor sensor (if used) to the ’T’ connections on the thermostat (wire run should not exceed 300’ [91m]). 3. Seal the hole in the wall with a suitable material to prevent drafts from entering the thermostat case. 4. Configure thermostat and equipment for system type, program the thermostat, and test system (see minimum configuration guide on back page or Programming and Application Guide). Wiring Diagrams Configure and test thermostat Press OPTIONS tab, then use the down arrow to select INSTALLER SETTINGS. Press ENTER; a note states MUST BE SET BY QUALIFIED PERSON". Press Enter again to access installer settings. INSTALLER SETTINGS −−−−−−−−−−−−−−−−−−−− SYSTEM SETUPĊWith SYSTEM SETUP selected, press enter. Set thermostat for operation with a heat pump or non-heat pump. Set number of compressor stages. Set number of backup heat stages. Defaults: Non−heat Pump, Gas/Oil, 2 compressor stages, 2 indoor heat stages. Use arrows to scroll through and select from the list; then press ENTER. SYSTEM SETUP NON HEAT PUMP HEAT PUMP COMPRESSOR STAGES INDOOR HEAT STAGES For NON HEAT PUMP, use arrows to select from the list; then press SAVE. NON HEAT PUMP NO HEAT GAS/OIL ELECTRIC For HEAT PUMP, use arrows to select from the list; then press SAVE. HEAT PUMP NO BACKUP HEAT DUAL FUEL (GAS/OIL) ELECTRIC For COMPRESSOR STAGES, use arrows to select 1 or 2 compressor stages; then press SAVE. COMPRESSOR STAGES 2 For INDOOR HEAT STAGES, use arrows to select 1 or 2 indoor heat stages; then press SAVE. INDOOR HEAT STAGES 2 SYSTEM TEST MODESĊPress OPTIONS tab, go to INSTALLER SETTINGS, then press up arrow twice to select SYSTEM TEST MODES. Press ENTER; select TEST OUTPUTS and press ENTER. SYSTEM TEST MODES TEST OUTPUTS Test all cooling, heating, Emergency Heating stages and FAN outputs. SCROLL arrows move through a list of all signals, Y1 ON, Y1 OFF, Y2 ON, Y2 OFF, etc. With a signal displayed, press ENTER to start the test, (e.g. Y1 ON selected, press ENTER brings on Y1; Y1 OFF selected, press ENTER shuts off Y1. CANCEL, pressed at anytime during tests will return the previous screen and also disable any test and puts the thermostat back into normal mode. CAUTION! − In dual fuel system applications, do not turn on heat pump and furnace at the same time in system test mode. All HVAC components can be tested to confirm the thermostat is sending signals to each unit. NOTES − After 5 minutes without a test being initiated, the test modes is disabled and system goes back to the normal mode (i.e. HOME screen). When in SYSTEM TEST MODE, the compressor minimum off timer is bypassed. TEST OUTPUTS OFF Y1 ON Y1 OFF Y2 ON Y2 OFF W1 ON W1 OFF W2 ON W2 OFF FAN (G) ON FAN (G) OFF H ON IMPORTANT! The test mode only energizes the outputs in the order you turn them on. When Y1 or Y2 is turned ON, the FAN (G) output remains OFF. With the system connected, the compressor will be energized without the fan, unless you first set the FAN (G) to ON, then turn on the Y1 output. H OFF D ON D OFF O ON (B OFF) B ON (O OFF)
